own_solution.law: Closed-open pipe resonance: L + e = (2k-1) lambda/4, lambda = v/f; successive resonance lengths differ by lambda/2; time = (lambda/2)/u for level-fall speed u

notes: lambda = 343/512 = 0.66992 m; lambda/2 = 33.496 cm; t = 33.496/1.5 = 22.33 s. With second tap on the same tube, rates add (each tap 'alone' gives its rate; constant rates as stated): 2.4 cm/s, t = 33.496/2.4 = 13.96 s. Initial column length 130 cm enters both resonance times t_k = (L_k - L0)/u and cancels in the difference. Second-tap sentences for an earlier run or the neighbouring tube are disconnected. Numeral-free sentences T3D7A, TB8E5 say 'a steady rate' instead of 0.9 cm/s.
